review.notes: Full review. Adversarial pass over every section with computed values (28 table rows). Dependency check: 0 problems. Automatic checks all passed; Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry as the only warning; one-tactic probe closes nothing. Findings: N-wave rate false for a C2 flux; C-infinity test class not equivalent without semicontinuity; Lax condition equivalence fails at equal limits; double ownership with open roadmap OptimalControlAndHamiltonJacobi; statable headlines absent from Suggested.lean.
